maya: Heads up — noticed a small but consistent delta in invoice preview for a handful of tenants after yesterday's route-proto canary. +20-80 tokens per session for some customers. anyone else seeing weird heartbeat/route tags?
liam: Saw same. Looks like the new route shim emits an ephemeral `route_tag=shadow` on retries, which our metering fanout treats as a new routing path.
sara: That would cause duplicate attribution if the fingerprinting key changes mid-session. Can we confirm which field the tallyer uses for sticky session?
jon: Tallyer uses `session_id` + `route_resolution_id` for attribution. If `route_resolution_id` flips on retry, tokens get split and the ledger consumer merges them as separate events, then preview doublecounts during the join window.
maya: Repro steps: canary -> force a transient 503 on primary -> proxy retries -> route-proto returns alt route with new tag -> ingest shows two distinct route_resolution_id values for same session.
liam: Minimal log excerpt from sidecar: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-22T21:11:02Z","session_id":"s-123","route_resolution_id":"rr-A","route_tag":"primary"}
{"ts":"2026-03-22T21:11:02Z","session_id":"s-123","route_resolution_id":"rr-B","route_tag":"shadow"}
```
ashley-billing: Oof. That pattern will create a race where preview snapshots include both fragments until aggregation window closes. Customers will see small inflations on previews/invoices. Need mitigation asap.
kate-devex: UX/console note — previews currently show per-route breakdown; splitting the same session across two routes will make the UI show two tiny lines. That's confusing to customers.
sara: Quick mitigation idea: during ingest, canonicalize route_resolution_id using the first-seen stable mapping (sticky mapping) for a session for N minutes. If a new `route_resolution_id` appears within that window with same session_id, treat as alias.
jon: We already have an alias map used for shard reassigns but it's not plumbed into the realtime join path. We could patch the joiner to check `session_origin` + earliest `route_resolution_id`. Risk: may mask true route swaps when customer intentionally switches models.
liam: What about adding a lightweight TTL-key on the fingerprint: `fingerprint_v2 = sha(session_id + tenant + stable_route_hint)` where `stable_route_hint` is `route_meta.fixed_hint || first_seen_route`. That avoids mutating downstream ledger keys.
maya: That seems safe and low-risk. Need perf check but joiner already computes a fingerprint.
ashley-billing: Time sensitivity — we should avoid any change that reprocesses committed ledger lines. Prefer ingest-side normalization (before ledger write) to prevent duplicates landing in preview pipelines.
jon: Agreed. Short plan: 1) patch proxy to stop emitting ephemeral `route_tag` on retry (quick rollback/guard) 2) ingest-side aliasing: look up first-seen `route_resolution_id` for session_id (cache 5m) and rewrite incoming events to canonical id 3) add a canary in preview pipeline to detect split-session counts and alert.
kate-devex: I'll add a temporary console note explaining preview quirks for affected tenants and surface the canary flag on their preview cards.
liam: I'll draft the ingest patch and a unit test for the alias cache. Jon, can you add the joiner sideguard to ignore tiny second fragments if the first fragment has >90% of tokens? That will be a safety net.
jon: Yep. Also adding telemetry: a gauge `metering.split_sessions.count` and histogram for tokens per split to help threshold tuning.
ops-bot: Incident created: MET-2026-148 "route-proto canary causing split-session token attribution" assigned to @liam and @jon. Priority: P2.
maya: Thanks. One more ask — billing wants a retroactive adjust run plan if we find invoices materially affected. Ashley?
ashley-billing: We'll triage after telemetry runs for 24h. If impact > $X threshold or > 0.5% tenants affected, we'll run a preview backfill and issue credits where appropriate. Keep me posted.
sara: I'll prepare a short test harness to simulate the retry -> route flip pattern and run it against canary and master to prove fix.
maya: Great. Action items: liam patch ingest alias cache (ETA 4h), jon joiner guard + telemetry (ETA 6h), rollback/proxy guard if easy (ops) — otherwise canary pause. Devex will add console note. Billing will watch for >24h and decide credits.
liam: On it. Pushing a branch now, will link PR in this thread.
jon: I'll follow up with the telemetry dashboard panel and an alert rule.
kate-devex: PRs and console note linked. Will also add a short FAQ blurb for CS.
maya: Thanks team. Keep replies short in-thread; if you need pairing ping me. :thumbsup:
